"""Fetches the public data files into the output folder and hands the folder on."""
import hashlib
import os
import ssl
import urllib.request

import certifi

import outputs.data.quake.QuakeFiles as out


def main(ctx):
    p = ctx.params()
    urls = [p.Urls(i).decode() for i in range(p.UrlsLength())]
    names = [p.Names(i).decode() for i in range(p.NamesLength())]
    context = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=certifi.where())
    rows = []
    for url, name in zip(urls, names):
        path = os.path.join(ctx.output_directory, name)
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Tsugumi demo"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180, context=context) as r, open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(r.read())
        data = open(path, "rb").read()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        print(f"{name}: {len(data)} bytes sha256 {digest} from {url}")
        rows.append(f"| `{name}` | {len(data):,} | `{digest[:16]}…` |")
    ctx.display_markdown(
        "**震源カタログを取る**\n\n| ファイル | bytes | SHA-256 |\n| --- | ---: | --- |\n" + "\n".join(rows)
        + "\n\n出典: USGS ComCat (earthquake.usgs.gov FDSN event service), 2000-2024, M >= 4"
    )
    b = ctx.builder()
    s = b.CreateString(ctx.output_directory)
    out.Start(b)
    out.AddValue(b, s)
    ctx.output("data", b, out.End(b))

import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import csv

from inputs.data.quake.QuakeFiles import QuakeFiles
import outputs.section.quake.SectionDir as out


def emit(ctx, port, out):
    b = ctx.builder()
    s = b.CreateString(ctx.output_directory)
    out.Start(b)
    out.AddValue(b, s)
    ctx.output(port, b, out.End(b))


def png(fig):
    import io
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=110, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf.getvalue()


def main(ctx):
    p = ctx.params()
    folder = ctx.input("data", QuakeFiles).Value().decode()
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(os.path.join(folder, sorted(os.listdir(folder))[0]))))
    ev = np.array([(float(r["latitude"]), float(r["longitude"]), float(r["depth"]), float(r["mag"]))
                   for r in rows if r.get("type") == "earthquake" and r["mag"] and r["depth"]])
    band = (ev[:, 0] >= p.LatMin()) & (ev[:, 0] <= p.LatMax())
    sel = ev[band]
    fig, (m, s) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.4), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1, 2.2]})
    m.scatter(ev[:, 1], ev[:, 0], s=1, c="#bbb")
    m.scatter(sel[:, 1], sel[:, 0], s=1, c="#E5484D")
    m.set_xlabel("longitude")
    m.set_ylabel("latitude")
    m.set_title(f"{len(ev)} events, band {p.LatMin():g}-{p.LatMax():g} N", fontsize=9)
    sc = s.scatter(sel[:, 1], sel[:, 2], s=(sel[:, 3] - 3) ** 2 * 3, c=sel[:, 3], cmap="plasma", alpha=0.6)
    s.invert_yaxis()
    s.set_xlabel("longitude")
    s.set_ylabel("depth [km]")
    s.set_title("cross-section (subducting Pacific slab)", fontsize=9)
    fig.colorbar(sc, ax=s, label="M")
    data = png(fig)
    with open(os.path.join(ctx.output_directory, "section.png"), "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(data)
    np.savetxt(os.path.join(ctx.output_directory, "selected.csv"), sel, delimiter=",",
               header="latitude,longitude,depth_km,mag", comments="", fmt="%.4f")
    print(f"{len(sel)} of {len(ev)} events between {p.LatMin():g} and {p.LatMax():g} N")
    ctx.display_image(data, "image/png", "Japan Trench: events and depth cross-section")
    emit(ctx, "section", out)

import os

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from inputs.section.quake.SectionDir import SectionDir
import outputs.fmd.quake.FmdDir as out


def emit(ctx, port, out):
    b = ctx.builder()
    s = b.CreateString(ctx.output_directory)
    out.Start(b)
    out.AddValue(b, s)
    ctx.output(port, b, out.End(b))


def png(fig):
    import io
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=110, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    return buf.getvalue()


def main(ctx):
    p = ctx.params()
    sel = np.loadtxt(os.path.join(ctx.input("section", SectionDir).Value().decode(), "selected.csv"),
                     delimiter=",", skiprows=1, ndmin=2)
    mags = sel[:, 3]
    mc, dm = p.Mc(), p.BinWidth()
    use = mags[mags >= mc - 1e-9]
    # Aki (1965) maximum likelihood with the bin correction of Utsu (1966).
    b = np.log10(np.e) / (use.mean() - (mc - dm / 2))
    b_err = b / np.sqrt(len(use))
    a = np.log10(len(use)) + b * mc
    grid = np.round(np.arange(mags.min(), mags.max() + dm, dm), 2)
    cum = np.array([np.sum(mags >= m - 1e-9) for m in grid])
    ok = cum > 0
    fit = grid >= mc
    with open(os.path.join(ctx.output_directory, "fmd.csv"), "w") as fh:
        fh.write("magnitude,N_ge_M\n" + "".join(f"{m:.1f},{n}\n" for m, n in zip(grid, cum)))
    print(f"{len(use)} events with M >= {mc:g}: b = {b:.2f} +/- {b_err:.2f}, a = {a:.2f}")
    ctx.display_line_chart([
        {"id": "observed", "label": "log10 N(>=M) observed", "x": grid[ok].tolist(), "y": np.log10(cum[ok]).tolist()},
        {"id": "fit", "label": f"Gutenberg-Richter fit b = {b:.2f} +/- {b_err:.2f} (M >= {mc:g})",
         "x": grid[fit].tolist(), "y": (a - b * grid[fit]).tolist()},
    ])
    emit(ctx, "fmd", out)

notes.html:
Gutenberg–Richter 則

マグニチュード MM 以上の地震の数 NN は

log⁡10N(≥M)=a−bM\log_{10} N(\ge M) = a - bM

に従い、bb はおよそ 1 です。最尤推定（Aki 1965、宇津 1966）では

b=log⁡10eMˉ−(Mc−ΔM/2)b = \frac{\log_{10} e}{\bar M - (M_c - \Delta M/2)}

section の緯度帯や b_value の McM_c を変えて、その Card だけを実行し直せます。

累積頻度を描き、最尤法で Gutenberg–Richter 則の b 値を求めます。
